title: Braven
description: A logger and his father head to their hunting cabin, hoping for a quiet weekend. Instead, they find themselves in a kill-or-be-killed stand for survival when they encounter a gang of ruthless drug traffickers.

title: Raw Deal
description: A former FBI agent (Arnold Schwarzenegger) infiltrates the biggest mob in Chicago and single-handedly wipes it out.

title: The Last Stand
description: A sheriff must take matters into his own hands when a notorious drug lord escapes from FBI custody and comes speeding toward a showdown in the lawman's quiet border town.

title: Diablo
description: Ex-con Kris Chaney seizes the daughter of a Colombian gangster to fulfill a noble promise to the young girl's mother. Her enraged father soon enlists both the criminal underworld and a psychotic killer to exact his revenge.

title: Rogue
description: A cynical American travel writer is among the stranded riverboat passengers who become fodder for a monstrous crocodile.

title: Detective Knight: Rogue
description: Mask-wearing robbers critically wound Detective James Knight's partner during a shootout. As Knight pursues the bandits from Los Angeles to New York, his dark past collides with his present case, threatening to tear his world apart.

title: Detective Knight: Redemption
description: In custody in New York, Detective James Knight finds himself in the middle of a jailbreak led by The Christmas Bomber, a brutal fanatic whose Santa Claus disciples are terrorizing the city.

title: Detective Knight: Independence
description: Detective James Knight's last-minute assignment to the Independence Day shift turns into a race against time to stop an unbalanced EMT worker who's posing as a cop.

title: Fire With Fire
description: A firefighter does something unexpected after a man that he has been ordered to testify against threatens him.

title: Wire Room
description: When gunmen break into a high-tech command center, a Homeland Security agent and a new recruit make a final, desperate stand against the corrupt agents and officials who seek to destroy evidence and kill them both.

title: Trauma Center
description: Alone and trapped in a locked-down hospital isolation ward overnight, an injured young woman must escape a pair of vicious killers who are after the only piece of evidence that can implicate them in a grisly murder: the bullet in her leg.

title: Reprisal
description: An ex-cop joins forces with a bank manager to track down a highly skilled and ruthless thief; the situation soon escalates when the robber kidnaps the manager's wife and daughter.

title: Survive the Game
description: An injured cop, his partner and a troubled veteran must use stealth, smarts and marksmanship to take down a drug-dealing gang at a remote farm.

title: Survive the Night
description: A trauma doctor is forced to operate on a wounded gunman as he and his family are held hostage by the man and his unhinged brother.

title: First Kill
description: Wall Street broker Will and his young son Danny witness the murder of a corrupt police officer while on a hunting trip. When the perpetrators take Danny hostage, Will must help them evade the police chief and recover stolen money to save his son.

title: Catch .44
description: The plan of three women (Malin Akerman, Nikki Reed, Deborah Ann Woll) to intercept a drug shipment for their boss (Bruce Willis) goes horribly wrong.

title: Marauders
description: FBI agents (Christopher Meloni, Dave Bautista) uncover a conspiracy while trying to nail a group of deadly bank robbers.
